caption:
A gentle reminder about death and returning to Allah

Allah tells us that every soul will taste death, and then to Him we will all be returned. Let it shape how you spend the hours you still have.

Surah Al-Ankaboot 29:57

Which good deed have you been putting off?

#rememberdeath #returntoallah #muslimreminder #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
